scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed with a colorblind-safe palette, clear typographic hierarchy, and a smart swarm+boxplot combo, but the top-earner callout labels cluster messily in the right margin with one label clipped at the viewport edge.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Log scale and uniform dot sizing are honest for income distribution, but xScale domain is hardcoded ([14000,550000]) instead of data-derived, breaking scaling robustness; box plot statistics and percentile lines are correctly computed from data.
scores.stress_test_note: Fully static chart with pre-computed force layout and no brush/zoom/transition interactions; only live interaction is pointer-event tooltip repositioning via CSS, which causes no DOM mutations or re-renders.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single conceptual view with 4 colorblind-safe categories, 400 force-settled dots forming a readable distribution, unobtrusive percentile lines, and a clean marginal box plot — complexity is well-managed with no overload.

proposer: Replaced two `forEach` loops with idiomatic D3 data joins — whisker caps and legend entries. Saves 3 lines (244→241) and uses consistent join patterns throughout.
